members.title: Members
members.description: People in this workspace and what they can do.
members.readOnly: Only workspace admins can change members and invites.
members.removeBody: {name} loses access to this workspace right away. You can invite them again later.
members.lastAdmin: A workspace needs at least one active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
members.failed: Couldn't save the change. Try again.

invites.title: Pending invites
invites.revokeBody: The link stops working right away.
invites.linkBody: Send this link to {email} yourself. It works once, expires in 72 hours, and is shown only now.
invites.alreadyMember: This person is already a member.
invites.failed: Couldn't create the invite. Check the email and try again.

roleHelp.EDITOR: Write scenarios, sites, environments and variables

link.missingBody: Open the full link you were sent. It ends with #token=…
link.invalidBody: Check that you copied the whole link, or ask for a new one.
link.expiredBody: Ask an admin to send you a new link.
link.usedTitle: This link has already been used
link.usedBody: Each link works only once. If that wasn't you, tell an admin.
link.revokedBody: An admin cancelled it or issued a newer one. Ask for the latest link.
link.rateLimitedBody: Wait a minute and open the link again.

accept.title: Join {workspace}
accept.wrongTitle: This invite is for a different account
accept.wrongBody: You're signed in as {current}, but the invite is for {email}. Sign out and continue with the invited account.
accept.signInBody: An account for {email} already exists. Sign in with it to join.
accept.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
accept.name: Your name
accept.accountExists: An account with this email already exists. Reload the page and sign in.
accept.externalHint: The account's verified email must be {email}.
accept.externalFailed: That account couldn't be used. Its email must be verified and match the invite.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.forEmail: For {email}. After this you're signed out everywhere.
reset.doneBody: All your sessions were signed out. Sign in with the new password.
reset.failed: Couldn't set the password. Try again.

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.description: Everyone with an account on this server. There's no email: hand reset links over yourself.
adminUsers.disableBody: {name} is signed out everywhere and can't sign in until enabled again.
adminUsers.linkBody: Send this link to {email} yourself. It works once, expires in 1 hour, and is shown only now. Older reset links for this user stop working.
adminUsers.lastAdmin: At least one instance admin must stay enabled, and every workspace needs an active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
adminUsers.self: You can't disable your own account.
adminUsers.failed: Couldn't save the change. Try again.

externalLogin.signup_not_allowed: There's no account for that sign-in yet. Ask a workspace admin for an invite, or use an email from an allowed domain.
externalLogin.account_not_linked: An account with this email already exists. Sign in the way you did before.
externalLogin.failed: Couldn't sign in with that provider. Try again.
